title: PhyAVBench: A Challenging Audio Physics-Sensitivity Benchmark for Physically Grounded Text-to-Audio-Video Generation
abstract: arXiv:2512.23994v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Text-to-audio-video (T2AV) generation is central to applications such as filmmaking and world modeling. However, current models often fail to produce physically plausible sounds. Previous benchmarks primarily focus on audio-video temporal synchronization, while largely overlooking explicit evaluation of audio-physics grounding, thereby limiting the study of physically plausible audio-visual generation. To address this issue, we present PhyAVBench, the first benchmark that systematically evaluates the audio-physics grounding capabilities of T2AV, image-to-audio-video (I2AV), and video-to-audio (V2A) models. PhyAVBench offers PhyAV-Sound-11K, a new dataset of 25.5 hours of 11,605 audible videos collected from 184 participants to ensure diversity and avoid data leakage. It contains 337 paired-prompt groups with controlled physical variations that drive sound differences, each grounded with an average of 17 videos and spanning 6 au

translated_title: PhyAVBench：一个面向物理接地文本到音视频生成的挑战性音频物理敏感性基准测试
translated_abstract: 文本到音视频（T2AV）生成是电影制作和世界建模等应用的核心。然而，当前模型往往难以生成物理上合理的声音。以往的基准测试主要关注音视频的时间同步性，而在很大程度上忽略了对音频-物理接地的显式评估，从而限制了对物理合理音视频生成的研究。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了PhyAVBench，这是首个系统评估T2AV、图像到音视频（I2AV）和视频到音频（V2A）模型的音频-物理接地能力的基准测试。PhyAVBench提供了PhyAV-Sound-11K数据集，这是一个新数据集，包含从184名参与者处收集的25.5小时、11,605个可听见视频，以确保多样性并避免数据泄露。它包含337组带有受控物理变化的配对提示，这些变化驱动了声音的差异，每组平均有17个视频作为依据，并涵盖6种音频……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: PhyAVBench是首个系统评估文本到音视频、图像到音视频和视频到音频模型音频-物理接地能力的基准测试，提供了包含11,605个可听视频的新数据集以及337组受控物理变化的配对提示，填补了以往基准只关注音视频同步而忽略物理合理性评估的空白。
